messages:
Alex - CSM: Heads-up — Sequoia preview opt-ins dropped to ~48% (was ~72%). 12 invites bounced on provisioning/SSO. If we don't fix, renewal conversations will be harder (they flagged early). Need a short ops plan: re-invite cadence, one-off enablement hours + quick troubleshooting doc.
Maya (Customer Ops): On it. Pulling the bounce list now and matching to account owners. Any priority accounts?
Alex - CSM: Priority: Sequoia-Prod, Sequoia-Analytics, and the account with the heavy query load (acct id 4482). Those are the ones the exec sponsor called about.
Irene (Onboard): I can host two office hours tomorrow 10:00-10:30 PT and 16:00-16:30 PT — quick walkthrough + SSO checklist. I can also prep a 1-pager for eng contacts. Want me to drop calendar invites or send a calendar + email nudge?
Sam R. (PM): Quick idea — add an in-console banner for invited users that haven't accepted after 3 days linking to the office hours and a "Need help?" triage flow. Low-friction and should lift conversion. I can raise a small config change with frontend today.
Jamal - Support: Sharing the top error from the logs: ```
ERROR 2026-10-12 14:22:03 403 SSORejected: missing SAML attribute "eduPersonPrincipalName" for user: jane@sequoia.com
``` 8 of the 12 bounces are SAML attribute failures, 4 are email bounces.
Maya (Customer Ops): Thanks Jamal. I'll split the list into SAML vs email and tag the account owners. For the email bounces I'll re-send from support@redwood-inference.com with manual follow-up.
Alex - CSM: Please include a short troubleshooting snippet in the resend: 1) Confirm SAML attr mapping, 2) Check IdP logs, 3) If email bounce, confirm mailbox policy and whitelist. Irene, can you draft that snippet?
Irene (Onboard): Yep — drafting now. Proposed copy for email/resend and Slack DM to sequoia eng: ``Hi — we saw an issue with your invite (SAML attribute / mailbox). Quick steps: 1) Verify attribute mapping for eppn/e-mail in IdP, 2) Ensure relay/forwarding isn't blocking, 3) If stuck, join our office hours at <cal link>. Reply here and we'll jump in.`` Would you like a shorter version for exec sponsor?
Alex - CSM: Shorter exec note: "We've identified provisioning bounces (SSO/email). Ops + support running targeted re-invite + office hours this week — will update by EOD Fri." Keep it tight.
Sam R. (PM): For the in-console banner I can push a content change: "Having trouble accepting your Sequoia preview invite? Click for help + book 1:1" — sends to a small triage form. I'll scope and post the PR this afternoon.
Maya (Customer Ops): Quick ask — can we surface these 3 flagged accounts to RenewalOps as "renewal-risk:medium" so AMs have a heads-up? They asked to be pinged when enrollment <60%.
Alex - CSM: Yes, please tag them. I already DM'd RenewalOps with the exec note, but let's add the formal tag.
Jamal - Support: I'll prepare the support threads and add the IdP logs where available. Also will attach the 4 bounced emails so CS can forward.
feedback-bot: Automated: Nudge email sent to 14 invited users at 16:00 PT. Responses so far: 6 replies (3 accepted, 2 SSO issues, 1 asked for later invite). Avg quick-satisfaction rating: 6/10.
Irene (Onboard): Good to know. I'll include a one-click reschedule link in the follow-up for the 1 who asked for later invite.
Alex - CSM: Action items: Maya — split list + re-invite by EOD; Jamal — attach logs & prepare mail bounces; Irene — draft 1-pager + email copy; Sam — scope banner PR. We'll regroup here after office hours and update RenewalOps. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Maya (Customer Ops): Got it. I'll post the split list in this thread when ready and tag account owners.
Alex - CSM: Closing loop — please update last_message_ts after you post the split list so I can include in the executive follow-up.
